title: VisualDCS: DCS-2026 — The Digital Corpus of Sanskrit as a validated, query-ready SQLite master with a 2021-2026 cross-walk
description: Interactive frequency dashboards and a validated, query-ready SQLite packaging of the Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), pinned to a fixed upstream commit with a 2021-2026 cross-walk. Cite the underlying corpus annotation separately (Hellwig, Oliver. The Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS). 2010-2024. CC BY 4.0).
